brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two bins installed: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full in adjacent cells (0,0,0 and 1,0,0) – suitable as utensil holders. build has 2 pieces + 2 bins, meshClash clear.

Build uses solid-wall full-depth bins (hex-bin-full, not drained) which are waterproof containers by geometry; however waterproof/dishwasher-safe is a material rating not enforced or verified by the configurator (no material property in catalog). No 'waterproof' part found in search. Recommend specifying food-grade PP/PETG bins if ordering.

finish.summary: Built 2-cell base with two solid full-depth bins as utensil holder. Waterproof holds by closed bin geometry but dishwasher-safe/material certification is outside configurator scope – marked partial.
